blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday was told by a “bagman” that he delivered cash-filled suitcases, or “maleta,” to Sen. Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, former Rep. Stella Quimbo, and former Sen. Antonio Trillanes. The Inquirer is still awaiting comments from Sotto and Quimbo, while Trillanes has denied the allegation.
